decision: Select R3, the tall floor-fed hooded-flywheel robot, on the carried-forward 680 mm swerve foundation. Switch to R3L if the BUMP crossing premise (F5) fails.
decidedBy: Whole-robot preliminary designer under delegated owner authority; students may reopen it with the listed evidence
commonConditions: Same frame (680 mm long; R3-PD2 widens it to 714 mm), four MAXSwerve corners at +/-265 mm along and +/-282 mm across the frame, V0 rules (construction-rules.json), own-zone role (kickoff/selected-strategy.md), 0.215 kg FUEL, HUB 2.43 m from the release point, weak pack 11.9-12.2 V at 0.020-0.026 ohm

candidates.name: R2C-T1 incumbent: serial shelf elevator, top wheel pair, rear screw lift
candidates.custody: Five handoffs (intake, cross-feed deck, shelf elevator, diverter and guide, scoring wheels). Measured: 24 released in 11.953 s but 3 scored; the closed hopper delivered 0 of 24.
candidates.shot: 7 of 9 contact-stiffness cases fall short; peaks 0.974-1.390 m against the 1.829 m opening. ballistics.json gives 5.8-7.8 m/s entry bands from 2.0-3.6 m at 0.43-0.70 m release, far above what the wheel pair produced.
candidates.massKg: No complete ledger. The climb model uses 62 kg gross; native CAD mass unresolved (325 kg with placeholder materials).
candidates.voltage: Not commissioned; screw lift registered at 23 A.
candidates.packaging: 754 mm stowed, 8 mm under R107; the engineering review found intake-roller/elevator interference and isolated parts.
candidates.capacity: 24 by the 3 x 4 x 2 box screen.
candidates.loads: Blocked-nut screw thrust 2.86-5.81 kN against a 2.44 kN thrust-bearing static rating (open).
candidates.givesUp: Nothing new; it is the baseline.

candidates.name: R3 tall floor-fed hood shooter (selected)
candidates.custody: Three handoffs (belt pinch on the bumper face, floor belt, flywheel pinch). The tracked FUEL passes 36 checked cycle cases from carpet to HUB cavity; its 28 strokes are fitted within 1.5 mm to the solved acquisition, entry, launch and delivery trials.
candidates.shot: The launch trial releases at 0.267 m, 6.86 m/s and 61.9 deg, 2.43 m from the HUB centre, from a 13.4 m/s wheel surface and a 12 mm wheel-to-hood squeeze. Delivery trials from that state score from 6.70 to 7.00 m/s at every drag and spin corner. The point-mass screen at that release gives 6.68-6.99 m/s nominal and 6.76-6.93 m/s under all four drag and spin corners. No robust band closer than 2.4 m, so the delivery pose moves to 2.7 m.
candidates.massKg: R103 37.2-50.4 kg against 52.16 (1.76 kg reserve); at most 57.9 with bumpers against R408's 61.23; running 53.1-70.2 kg.
candidates.voltage: Weak-pack minimum 7.66 V in loaded transit against 7.5 V required; launch 8.34 V against 8.0 V.
candidates.packaging: All 36 cycle cases and 2 service withdrawals pass; displaced-hood control rejected. Swept through every case: 750 mm tall, front extension 244.6 mm, no rear or side extension, one side at a time, no start overhang. The shooter withdrawal is checked with the floor lane empty.
candidates.capacity: Free volume gives 37.7-46.0 FUEL at 0.45-0.55 packing.
candidates.loads: Hang at 70.3 kg: about 345 N per hook and about 634 N bumper-to-upright reaction, on 23.9 mm of overlap per upright with the 714 mm frame; the side-view hang trial holds 37.5 mm (gate G3).
candidates.fieldAccess: Own zone; BUMP crossing screen gives 8.7 mm least clearance (front bumper corner) and 24.3 mm at the belly with the 100 mm floor (gate G6).
candidates.givesUp: TRENCH passage and a higher release point.

candidates.name: R3L low trench-runner, same allocation under 535 mm
candidates.shot: Same floor-fed hood; release 68 mm lower.
candidates.massKg: About 1 kg lighter than B (shorter walls and tubes).
candidates.packaging: Hook top 534 mm passes the 565.15 mm TRENCH with 31 mm. Its climber needs about a 200 mm telescoping raise before the swing, one more motion than B.
candidates.capacity: Free volume 115.7 L deployed: 29.4-35.9 FUEL at 0.45-0.55 packing. Meets 24 with less margin.
candidates.fieldAccess: Own zone plus both TRENCHES; no BUMP crossing (26 mm belly).
candidates.givesUp: About 8-10 FUEL of capacity, one climber motion and the BUMP crossing option.

candidates.name: Direct deposit (raise the hopper to the opening)
candidates.rejectedBy: R107 limits the robot's own height to 762 mm; the opening edge is 1828.8 mm. Infeasible without launching.

rankings.note: 1 is best; equal numbers are ties. Time means time to a robot that meets the selected role.
rankings.sensitivity: B leads C on capacity margin and one fewer climber motion. C's TRENCH access is geometric fact, while B's neutral-zone access rests on a 4 mm BUMP breakover margin. If F5 fails, rank C first on risk and select it.
rankings.releaseHeightTradeoff: A 0.60-0.70 m release (a vertical kicker into a top flywheel) still enters from 2.0 m, so it keeps the rehearsed 2.16 m delivery pose at the cost of one more transfer. Choose it if the reopened rehearsal shows the 2.7 m pose costs more cycle time than that transfer risks.

capacityMethod: free_volume() subtracts every robot solid from the walled hopper envelope with exact booleans and divides by the FUEL volume at 0.45-0.55 packing (wall effects at a container-to-piece ratio near 4). A rigid stacked lattice (capacity()) finds only 8 in R3 and 7 in R3L and is reported as a lower bound, not a decision measure. Neither is a dynamic fill.
invalidates: cad/own-zone-upper (R2C intake, elevator shelves, hopper, diverter and scoring wheels): superseded for detailing
cad/tower-lift and the experiments/tower-climb head-support, brake and mast studies (R2C-T1 screw lift): retained as history, not carried into R3
cad/assembly-release battery cradle and electronics deck positions: R3 moves the battery to the left side on its end and the electronics to both side strips
kickoff field rehearsal delivery steps at about 2.16 m from the HUB centre: R3 delivers from 2.7 m (delivery-pose premise reopens conceptual design)
carriedForward: 680 mm frame length and rails, module saddles at +/-265 mm along the frame (the 714 mm width moves them to +/-282 mm across, to be redrawn) and their supplier-fit checks (provisional until the R3 mounts are drawn)
Bumper zone 48-168 mm and 76 mm section

mostLikelyInvalidatingPremise.premise: Bulk FUEL feeds from the hopper floor into the two flywheel pinch lanes at 2 FUEL/s or faster without jamming
mostLikelyInvalidatingPremise.budget: One bench day with two belts, a flywheel lane pair and the hood at the R3 positions
mostLikelyInvalidatingPremise.nominal: Pass if 24 FUEL loaded as a heap give at least 22 pinch-sensor crossings in 12 s with at most one jam in five trials
mostLikelyInvalidatingPremise.adverse: 30 FUEL with the rig tilted 10 degrees toward a side plate; pass if no jam needs a reversal longer than 0.5 s
mostLikelyInvalidatingPremise.onFail: Revise to a rotating indexer or a third lane; if that also fails, reopen the whole-robot comparison

rehearsal: Re-run on Agent FRC 0.84 with waitCycles yield and a shared partner deconfliction (rehearsal/comparison.json). Baseline, R3 and R3L depot have 0 permanent wait cycles. Slot 2 credits 124 FUEL in both the baseline and R3 at 2.7 m (alliance totals 366 and 382). R3L depot matches R3; R3L on the TRENCH credits 40 (21 permanent cycles sharing the corridor with the neutral runner; 0 when solo, still 40). R3 stays selected. Pre-0.84 results (96 vs 104) were understated by permanent wait cycles.
